# Provenance of the `.gz` fixtures

Every `.gz` in this directory is committed byte-for-byte; the corpus in
`tests/vectors.rs` (generated by `gen_vectors.py` in the repository
root) inlines the same bytes as hex, and `reference.json` pins what the
decoder produces for each. The committed bytes are canonical. This file
records how each one was produced so they stay reproducible.

Two provenance classes:

* **gzip(1)-generated** — produced by the real `gzip` CLI (gzip 1.14),
  deterministic because `-n` suppresses both the MTIME field and the
  FNAME field, leaving nothing input-dependent in the header.
* **crafted** — packed by `make_fixtures.py` (beside this file) from
  Python's `zlib`, because the CLI cannot emit FEXTRA or FHCRC and
  cannot pin an exact FLG combination. Every crafted member is raw
  DEFLATE (method 8, level 9) with MTIME 0, XFL 2, OS 3.

Regenerate everything from this directory with
`python make_fixtures.py` (requires `gzip` on PATH) and compare against
the SHA-256 values below.

| file             | bytes | provenance | generation |
|------------------|-------|------------|------------|
| `hello.gz`       | 77    | gzip(1)    | `printf 'Hello, gzip! The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.\n' \| gzip -9 -n` |
| `empty.gz`       | 20    | gzip(1)    | empty input through `gzip -9 -n` |
| `two-members.gz` | 97    | gzip(1)    | `printf 'the first member's payload, repeated. ' \|[...]\| gzip -6 -n` concatenated with `printf 'second member\n' \| gzip -1 -n` (the multi-member case) |
| `binary.gz`      | 327   | gzip(1)    | 4096 structured bytes `(i * 7919) % 256` through `gzip -9 -n` (incompressible: stored blocks inside the member) |
| `fextra.gz`      | 44    | crafted    | FLG `FEXTRA`; subfield SI1 `'p'` SI2 `'h'` SLEN 4 data `01 02 03 04` |
| `fname.gz`       | 45    | crafted    | FLG `FNAME`; name `payload.txt` |
| `fcomment.gz`    | 72    | crafted    | FLG `FCOMMENT`; comment `crafted for the pith-inflate corpus` |
| `fhcrc.gz`       | 35    | crafted    | FLG `FHCRC`; CRC16 = CRC-32 of the header bytes so far, low 16 bits |
| `all-flags.gz`   | 141   | crafted    | FLG `FTEXT\|FEXTRA\|FNAME\|FCOMMENT\|FHCRC` (`0x1f`); every optional field at once |

```
803e60938387a279893256dd1099641bb0feaec78b6a245df80aa6227669edc0  hello.gz
f61f27bd17de546264aa58f40f3aafaac7021e0ef69c17f6b1b4cd7664a037ec  empty.gz
bc15328edb0fbaffbbf55f13a0c60edf48e5787af65454019cf36b7b6c77b6e3  two-members.gz
e2aacc243952d8eadaf8a6e06a4cff69f53b2debc4ad3030c323e9583a335248  binary.gz
35d292c486017a192f72079937ce65f62e1231f4994ee2ee6537c266724453c2  fextra.gz
8ab4aa226956e3aebb1e79b1398997a1da5d5473094ff187ad14c4ea7f20a7de  fname.gz
7ba9ae89526f3e726d33e670a64a23fe1b15022949e914516d2645be7a241601  fcomment.gz
62b7332faa1f0721ed6743001524fe5449ab06346932e90ea83ffafad96bdb8b  fhcrc.gz
469fea1f6c6855ed9f0abf7adeaa46f69c5b3e721b5d89a0ad7859fc275a2f25  all-flags.gz
```

The member payloads each fixture compresses are spelled out in
`make_fixtures.py`; the truncated/corrupt gzip error vectors are *not*
committed as files - they are one-defect mutations built in
`gen_vectors.py` (flip a magic byte, truncate the header, corrupt the
CRC16/CRC-32/ISIZE) so each names exactly the check it defeats.
